Title: Sword of Nuln + Taste of Vitae

Messages.Author: Tdog
Messages.Body:
Does a taste of vitae yeild the doubled amount if I use sword of Nuln to strike?

Sword of Nuln:
Equipment
(Tremere)
Unique melee weapon.
Strike: strength damage. Vampires must spend twice the normal amount of blood to heal the damage from this weapon's strikes.

Taste of Vitae:
Combat
Only usable at the end of a round of combat. Not usable by a vampire being burned or going to torpor.
This vampire gains an amount of blood equal to the amount lost by the opposing vampire to damage during this round. A vampire may play only one Taste of Vitae each round.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Yes.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
> Pascal wrote:
> The answer was already  here (but I do agree that's quite uneasy to find  )
>
I do not believe this should be the case, because 6.4.6 makes it quite clear there is a difference between "damage inflicted" and "blood spent to heal the damage".

Taste of Vitae says This vampire gains an amount of blood equal to the amount lost by the opposing vampire to damage.... It doesn't say "This vampire gains an amount of blood equal to the amount lost by the opposing vampire to HEALING..."

Sword of Nuln says Strike: strength damage. Vampires must spend twice the normal amount of blood to heal the damage from this weapon's strikes. It doesn't say "Strike: strength damage. THIS WEAPON DOES twice the normal amount of damage...".

Therefore, I believe this ruling to be in error, and we should reverse it. Or change the rulebook.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Taste of Vitae doesn't check the amount of damage inflicted, but the blood lost (spent healing or preventing destruction) due to that inflicted damage.
